tools.name: import_post_from_url
tools.description: Fetches an HTML article from a given URL and imports it into the CMS as a draft post, using the page title and body text.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the article page to import

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug to assign to the draft

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from langchain_core.tools import tool

CMS_API = os.environ.get("CMS_API", "http://localhost:8080/api")
CMS_TOKEN = os.environ.get("CMS_TOKEN", "")


def _extract(html):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    title = soup.title.string.strip() if soup.title and soup.title.string else "Untitled"
    paragraphs = [p.get_text(" ", strip=True) for p in soup.find_all("p")]
    return title, "\n\n".join(paragraphs)


@tool
def import_post_from_url(url: str, category: str = "uncategorized") -> str:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    title, body = _extract(resp.text)
    payload = {"title": title, "content": body, "status": "draft", "category": category}
    r = requests.post(
        f"{CMS_API}/posts",
        json=payload,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {CMS_TOKEN}"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return f"Created draft post {r.json().get('id')} titled '{title}'"

tools.name: fetch_featured_image
tools.description: Downloads an image from a URL and saves it to the blog's media library folder, returning the saved file path.

params.name: image_url
params.description: URL of the image to download

params.name: filename
params.description: Filename to save the image as in the media library

tools.code:
import os
import httpx
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("blog-media")

MEDIA_DIR = os.environ.get("MEDIA_DIR", "./media")


def _safe_name(name):
    return os.path.basename(name).replace(" ", "-")


@mcp.tool()
def fetch_featured_image(image_url: str, filename: str) -> str:
    os.makedirs(MEDIA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    with httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True, timeout=20) as client:
        resp = client.get(image_url)
        resp.raise_for_status()
    path = os.path.join(MEDIA_DIR, _safe_name(filename))
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(resp.content)
    return f"Saved {len(resp.content)} bytes to {path}"
